text: The lump cheese is already soured by its day of fermentation, so it stretches in hot water without any extra acid, the way pasta filata curd does.

steps.name: pull

processing.text: This is the lump cheese that is steamed: milk at 32 C with rennet and lactic bacteria (species not named), curd left to ferment for about a day. It is already soured, so it stretches in hot water without extra acid.
